title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE SMALL FIXES
why: The card was stamped v20.59 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names a few of the small fixes from the bug hunt (v20.60 to v20.72); the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names some of the small fixes.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
